name: Fantasy Maps
original_description:
Describe an imaginary place and its geography and get a map with the place names you choose labeled on it: a world, a continent, a kingdom, an island, a city or a dungeon.

The plugin prepares a draft with the map type, the style (aged parchment, black ink, full-color atlas) and the format. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the map and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For game masters, novelists and game designers.

Limitations: imaginary places from text only. It does not map real places, provide navigation, or edit an uploaded map. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
summary_ja: 文章で架空の国や都市、ダンジョンなどの地図画像を作る。
limitations_ja: 架空の場所のみ。現実の地図・道案内・画像の編集は対象外。 生成にはAbracadabraxへのサインインと生成前の確認が必要と説明。
